title: Motorbike
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' >
  <!-- shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='42' ry='6' fill='#1a2a4a' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- rear wheel -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='72' r='14' fill='#2a3a5a'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='72' r='14' fill='none' stroke='#4a7aaa' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='72' r='8' fill='#3a5a8a'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='72' r='8' fill='none' stroke='#6a9acc' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='72' r='3' fill='#8ab8e8'/>

  <!-- front wheel -->
  <circle cx='75' cy='72' r='14' fill='#2a3a5a'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='72' r='14' fill='none' stroke='#4a7aaa' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='72' r='8' fill='#3a5a8a'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='72' r='8' fill='none' stroke='#6a9acc' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='72' r='3' fill='#8ab8e8'/>

  <!-- frame / body -->
  <path d='M25 68 L35 52 L50 48 L62 50 L75 68' fill='#e85a4a' stroke='#f08070' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- fuel tank -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='46' rx='14' ry='7' fill='#f07060'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='44' rx='12' ry='4' fill='#ff9a8a' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- seat -->
  <path d='M30 50 Q35 42 48 42 L48 48 Q36 46 32 52 Z' fill='#3a4a6a' stroke='#5a7a9a' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- handlebar stem -->
  <line x1='68' y1='50' x2='75' y2='68' stroke='#c0d0e0' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='68' y1='50' x2='68' y2='40' stroke='#c0d0e0' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- handlebars -->
  <line x1='62' y1='40' x2='74' y2='40' stroke='#d0e0f0' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='44' r='4' fill='#ffee66' stroke='#fff8b0' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- exhaust pipe -->
  <path d='M35 58 Q25 60 22 66' fill='none' stroke='#c0c8d8' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- engine detail -->
  <rect x='40' y='52' width='12' height='8' rx='2' fill='#8090a8' stroke='#a0b0c8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='43' y1='52' x2='43' y2='60' stroke='#a0b0c8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='49' y1='52' x2='49' y2='60' stroke='#a0b0c8' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- little sparkles -->
  <circle cx='18' cy='48' r='1.5' fill='#ffee66' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='52' r='1.5' fill='#ffee66' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
